title: A Lightweight Hybrid Approach for Milling Force Reconstruction from Internal Machine Signals
abstract: arXiv:2611.25921v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Data-driven monitoring based on milling force can enable advanced manufacturing services including process optimization and condition monitoring. However, industrial implementation is often hindered by costly and intrusive hardware and large training data requirements. This paper therefore presents a hybrid approach using machine-internal signals and machining metadata to enable force-based monitoring on brownfield machines without additional sensors. Commonly available machine signals have relatively low sampling rates and cannot directly represent high-frequency milling-force variations, especially at higher spindle speeds. Instead of learning the complete force signal, which would increase model complexity, data requirements, and overfitting risk, a supervised machine-learning model predicts only the average milling force from selected machine-signal features and machining parameters. translated_title: 一种基于机床内部信号重构铣削力的轻量化混合方法
translated_abstract: 基于铣削力的数据驱动监测可以支持工艺优化和状态监测等先进制造服务。然而，其工业落地常常受到昂贵且具侵入性的硬件以及大量训练数据需求的阻碍。因此，本文提出了一种利用机床内部信号和加工元数据的混合方法，无需额外传感器即可在既有（brownfield）机床上实现基于力的监测。常用的机床信号采样率相对较低，无法直接表征高频的铣削力变化，尤其是在较高的主轴转速下。与学习完整的力信号（这会增加模型复杂度、数据需求和过拟合风险）不同，本文采用监督式机器学习模型，仅从选定的机床信号特征和加工参数预测平均铣削力。这一低频估计值再用于对统计……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种轻量化混合方法，利用机床内部信号和加工元数据，通过监督学习模型预测平均铣削力，从而在无需额外传感器的既有机床上实现基于力的铣削过程监测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a lightweight hybrid approach that uses machine-internal signals and machining metadata to predict the average milling force via a supervised learning model, enabling force-based milling monitoring on brownfield machines without additional sensors.
